# Oxford English Dictionary

> > The definitive historical dictionary of the English language, documenting word origins, etymologies, and usage from Old English to the present day.

The OED is the world's most comprehensive and authoritative dictionary, tracing the development of English words through historical citations and linguistic analysis. It covers etymology from Latin, French, Middle English, and other source languages, with detailed pronunciation guides and usage examples spanning centuries.

## Key Topics

- Etymology and word origins
- Historical linguistics
- Latin borrowings
- French borrowings
- Middle English
- Obsolete and archaic words
- Lexicography
- Pronunciation and phonetics
- British English vs U.S. English
- Word frequency and usage
- 16th-century language
- Historical citations
- Morphology and word formation
- Semantic development
- Taxonomic and technical terminology
